body:
Hi Churchwell team,

I looked through churchwellplumbing.com this week, and here is the honest problem: your homepage never actually lists your services. The page is mostly banner images and testimonials, your mission statement is locked inside a picture, and your phone number only appears once, right down at the very bottom. Someone with a burst pipe or a backed up sewer line lands there and cannot quickly see that you do trenchless sewer replacement, slab leaks, or water heaters, or how to call you.

I have redesigned the homepage for you, and it is attached to this email as a PDF. Your services are laid out in plain text near the top, your number sits in the header where it belongs, and your since 1989 story and customer reviews get the space they deserve.

Plumbing sites are familiar ground for me. I built Total Plumbing (totalplumbing.net), a plumbing company site with clear services and easy contact options. I also built Plumbing Masters (plumbingmastersokc.com), designed to turn visitors into calls.

If you like it, I can move it onto your real domain and build the remaining pages. If not, the PDF is yours to keep as ideas.

Best,
Hassan
name: Churchwell Plumbing
subject: 🔧 Your homepage does not list a single service you offer
